description: UrMoAC provides accessibility calculations on multimodal transport graphs, with OpenStreetMap import helpers and modes including walking, cycling, cars and public transport. The provider is DLR. Geographical and temporal coverage: Users supply the network and origins or destinations; geographical coverage and resolution therefore depend on the application. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): EPL-2.0. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
